{'外界普遍預期 Apple 將於本月底前推出全新配備 OLED 屏幕的 iPad mini。今日一則可信度存疑的新傳聞再次聲稱，新 iPad mini 將改用 OLED 屏幕，但仍維持 60Hz 刷新率，不支援 ProMotion。': 'The outside world generally expects Apple to launch a brand-new iPad mini with an OLED screen before the end of this month. Today, a new rumour with questionable credibility once again claims that the new iPad mini will switch to an OLED screen, but will still maintain a 60Hz refresh rate and will not support ProMotion.'}

{'OLED 版 iPad mini 可能缺少 ProMotion': 'The OLED version of the iPad mini may lack ProMotion'}

{'這已經是我們第二次聽到這個傳聞，但兩次都來自同一個消息來源：Naver 上的 yeux1122 帳戶。該帳戶對 Apple 傳聞的可信度參差不齊，往往似乎是在轉述匿名來源的資訊，而非提供獨家消息。': "This is the second time we have heard this rumour, but both times it has come from the same source: the yeux1122 account on Naver. The account's credibility on Apple rumours is mixed, and it often seems to be relaying information from anonymous sources rather than providing exclusive news."}

{'儘管如此，yeux1122 的最新帖文聲稱，部分「海外來源」提及新 OLED iPad mini 將有 120Hz，但「國內生產規模已經確認」將採用 60Hz 屏幕。': "Nevertheless, yeux1122's latest post claims that some 'overseas sources' mentioned the new OLED iPad mini will have 120Hz, but that 'domestic production scale has confirmed' it will use a 60Hz screen."}

{'同樣地，我對這則傳聞持相當大的懷疑態度，因為目前未有其他可靠消息來源加以證實。': 'Similarly, I hold considerable scepticism about this rumour, as there are currently no other reliable sources to corroborate it.'}

{'然而，如果屬實，這對 iPad mini 買家來說將是一個令人失望的局限。預期今次 iPad mini 升級將帶來多項其他顯著改進，包括：': 'However, if true, this will be a disappointing limitation for iPad mini buyers. This iPad mini upgrade is expected to bring several other notable improvements, including:'}

  • {'OLED 顯示屏。': 'An OLED display.'}
  • {'由現時 iPad mini 所採用的 A17 Pro 晶片，升級至 Apple A20 Pro 晶片。': 'An upgrade from the A17 Pro chip currently used in the iPad mini to the Apple A20 Pro chip.'}
  • {'經重新設計，邊框更窄，並可能具備更佳的防水效能。': 'A redesigned body with narrower bezels and potentially improved water resistance.'}
  • {'FaceTime 鏡頭將移至橫向邊框，與 Apple 其他 iPad 型號看齊。': "The FaceTime camera will be moved to the landscape edge, aligning with Apple's other iPad models."}

{'如果 Apple 作出了以上所有改動，卻偏偏在屏幕方面未升級至 120Hz ProMotion，將令新 iPad mini 的發佈大打折扣。': 'If Apple makes all the above changes yet fails to upgrade the display to 120Hz ProMotion, it will significantly diminish the launch of the new iPad mini.'}

{'新 iPad mini 預計於本月底正式推出，距離揭曉真相已為期不遠。': 'The new iPad mini is expected to launch officially at the end of this month, and the moment of truth is not far away.'}

{'你怎麼看？新 iPad mini 會否配備 ProMotion 與 120Hz 刷新率？歡迎在留言區告訴我們。': 'What do you think? Will the new iPad mini feature ProMotion and a 120Hz refresh rate? Feel free to let us know in the comments.'}
